caption: The drawing shows a set of double wooden doors with an arched top set into a stone doorway. Each door is reddish-brown with darker wavy vertical lines and is framed by a rectangular border. The doors feature a single brass or golden knocker on the left door. The arch above the doors is made of light yellow stone blocks, and the doorway is flanked by two squared columns that match the color and material of the arch, both with red vertical accents running down their length. The base of each column and the step below the doors are rendered in a similar yellow stone. The ground in front of the entrance appears to be made up of reddish-brown bricks. The background is a plain, light beige, functioning as a wall, with no additional objects or decorations visible. The artist's signature "LEMMON" is located in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Mission Doors
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
